#!/bin/bash
# The main cell of the definitive measures at 1M with dense doc ids, twice
# (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "la celda principal con doc
# ids densos, dos veces", pre-registered on 2026-11-28 by the user's order):
# dbpedia 1M, routing, 8 callers, the base m2 at 8ed921ed59 with the night
# harness and PE_DENSE (the doc id of a vector is its place in the order of
# arrival). After each growth, its recall and loads over the first 1 000
# queries. The binary is built before (dense.test); nothing here builds.
# Timed: marker, idle wait, caffeinate. Each index is removed once read.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
W=$S/def1m/dense
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/dbpedia-openai-1000k-angular.bin
BASE=$S/diag/m2/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge
mkdir -p $W

printf 'the main cell at 1M with dense doc ids, twice (def1m/dense.sh), timed, since %s for about an hour; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

clear_index() {
  find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/def1m/dense -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}

run() { # name
  local C=$W/$1
  local free=$(df -k $W | tail -n 1 | awk '{print int($4/1048576)}')
  if [ "$free" -lt 14 ]; then
    date "+== %H:%M:%S $1 NOT RUN: $free GiB free, under 14"
    return
  fi
  mkdir -p $C
  date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S $1: grow, routing, 8 callers, dense doc ids (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
  (cd $BASE && exec env PE_DENSE=1 PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$C/index PE_OUT=$C/grow.json PE_CALLERS=8 PE_CACHE=routing \
    PE_STRETCH=60 PE_MINFREE=3 $S/def1m/dense.test -test.run '^TestNightGrow$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $C/grow.log 2>&1) &
  local pid=$!
  python3 -I -B $S/def1m/monitor.py $pid $C/monitor.jsonl 10 > $C/monitor.err 2>&1 &
  wait $pid
  echo "$1 grow exit $?"
  wait
  date "+== %H:%M:%S $1: points (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
  (cd $BASE && PE_DENSE=1 PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$C/index PE_CACHE=routing PE_POINTS=$C/points.json PE_THREADS=8 PE_QUERIES=1000 \
    $S/def1m/dense.test -test.run '^TestNightPoints$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $C/points.log 2>&1)
  echo "$1 points exit $?"
  du -sk $C/index/lsm $C/index/*.postingedge.d | awk '{printf "%.2f GB  %s\n", $1/976562.5, $2}' | sed "s#$C/##"
  clear_index
}

run d1
run d2
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done (idle $(hid_idle) s)" | tee $W/end.txt
pmset -g log 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+ \+[0-9]+ (Sleep|Wake|DarkWake)' | tail -n 5 > $W/pmset-sleep-wake.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
